## Punjab – Land Classification (2023)

**What the portal shows**

The Land Classification section (section id `land-cover`) reports each year's net class areas for Punjab, drawn from Impact Observatory's 10 m annual land-use/land-cover product (io-lulc-annual-v02, Microsoft Planetary Computer), measured on its 80 m overview grid. The classification covers essentially all of Punjab's land: 50.62 million acres classified out of 50.61 million acres total (100 %).

**2023 class areas**

| Class | Area (million acres) | Share of classified land |
|---|---|---|
| **Crops** (most widespread) | 30.53 | 60.3 % |
| Built area | 3.82 | 7.6 % |
| Trees | 0.60 | 1.2 % |
| Rangeland, bare ground, etc. | remainder | – |

Crops was the most widespread class in both 2017 and 2023.
